scope: Legacy NC ingestion; source coverage 2010 through 2026; evidence inventory only, no target types or rekey plan.

definitions.filing_rows: Raw published CSV rows, including repeat appearances by county; not unique candidates or contests.
definitions.county_contest_party_groups: Distinct (date, exact normalized title, reporting county, party_contest); reporting groups, not proven electorates.
definitions.municipal_prefix: Exact CITY OF / TOWN OF / VILLAGE OF signal only; historical unprefixed municipal names are not counted.
definitions.unexpired: Source term attribute; TRUE neither proves general phase nor separates primary from second primary; FALSE does not exclude special/rerun.
definitions.distinct_title_type_group_ids: Source (title, type, group ID), without treating county overlaps as one electorate. Legacy group IDs absent.
definitions.source_record_counts: Via-race and via-candidate counts are separate paths and must not be added without overlap checking.
definitions.evidence_not_migration: No target canonical keys, automatic classifications, merges, deletions, or election creations are authorized by this inventory.
